_comment: Measured by a generator kept in the maintainers' private repository, not written by hand: it is regenerated after a change to the banding in okf-duplicates.py. recall: the share of planted body pairs, whose exact overlap is the threshold (jaccard, which is the threshold or a little above it: the pairs have whole numbers of shared shingles), that okf-check --duplicates-body listed. show_below: okf-check prints the recall when body_threshold is below this, the lowest measured threshold from which recall is at least 0.99.

measured.generator: kept in the maintainers' private repository, not shipped here

parameters.family: each pair shares one run of words; all other words are unique random tokens
